title: Smart Agriculture Research Center FTP UGM Participates in NVAITC Launch Preparation for Strengthening AI Research in Precision Agriculture

body:
By: Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty

Yogyakarta, March 13, 2026 – Smart Agricultural Research Center, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM) participated in the Pre Kick-Off Meeting to prepare for the NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) Launch Event held online on Friday (13/3). This meeting was part of initial coordination between UGM and industry partners in preparing the launch of a collaboration center for artificial intelligence development that will support various research innovations, including in the precision agriculture sector.

The involvement of the FTP UGM team in this activity is part of efforts to strengthen the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology and high-performance computing in the development of modern agricultural systems that are adaptive to tropical conditions. Through this collaboration center, various research related to land monitoring, precision irrigation management, and agricultural data analysis based on sensors and Internet of Things (IoT) are expected to develop more optimally. In the meeting, participants discussed various preparations ahead of the NVAITC launch event, including the determination of organizing committees from UGM, Indosat, and NVIDIA, as well as discussions on logistical aspects of the activity such as timing, location, invitation lists, and preparation of the event rundown. Additionally, the readiness of the collaboration center's infrastructure was discussed, which includes preparation of shared space (joint-center) and integration of computing systems between UGM's local servers and Indosat's Merdeka GPU infrastructure located on Cloudeka's platform, which is owned by Lintasarta.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/653-1-image-14-1030x739.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/653-2-image-3-1030x579.webp)

During the meeting, the technology framework provided by NVIDIA and Indosat to support the development of the Tropical Precision Agriculture project was also introduced. This technology includes support for data processing from various sources such as drones, cameras, and field sensors, data processing at edge devices, development of artificial intelligence models, and analytics and visualization systems that can support decision-making in data-driven agricultural management.

As one of the research teams that will contribute to the research showcase, the FTP UGM team is preparing various precision agriculture technology innovations that leverage the integration of field sensors, data analysis, and artificial intelligence to improve the efficiency of land management and agricultural resources. This effort aligns with the commitment to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) through improved agricultural productivity, SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure) through the use of artificial intelligence technology, and SDG 13 (Climate Action) through the development of adaptive and data-driven agricultural systems.

Through its involvement in the development of NVAITC, the FTP UGM team reaffirms its commitment to developing data-driven and artificial intelligence-based precision agriculture technology innovations that are applicable and sustainable. This collaboration between higher education institutions and industry is expected to strengthen research development and promote digital transformation in the agricultural sector.

original.body:
Oleh: Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty 

Yogyakarta, 13 Maret 2026 – Smart Agricultural Research Center Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM) mengikuti _Pre Kick-Off Meeting_ persiapan NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) Launch Event yang diselenggarakan secara daring pada Jumat (13/3). Pertemuan ini menjadi bagian dari koordinasi awal antara UGM dan mitra industri dalam mempersiapkan peluncuran pusat kolaborasi pengembangan kecerdasan artifisial yang akan mendukung berbagai inovasi riset, termasuk di sektor pertanian presisi. 

Keterlibatan tim FTP UGM dalam kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari upaya memperkuat integrasi teknologi Artificial Intelligence (AI) dan komputasi berperforma tinggi dalam pengembangan sistem pertanian modern yang adaptif terhadap kondisi tropis. Melalui pusat kolaborasi ini, berbagai penelitian terkait pemantauan lahan, pengelolaan irigasi presisi, hingga analisis data pertanian berbasis sensor dan _Internet of Things_ (IoT) diharapkan dapat berkembang lebih optimal. Dalam pertemuan tersebut, para peserta membahas berbagai persiapan menjelang pelaksanaan acara peluncuran NVAITC, termasuk penentuan panitia penyelenggara dari UGM, Indosat, dan NVIDIA, serta pembahasan aspek logistik kegiatan seperti waktu, lokasi, daftar undangan, dan penyusunan _rundown_ acara. Selain itu, dibahas pula kesiapan infrastruktur pusat kolaborasi yang meliputi persiapan ruang bersama (_joint-center_) serta integrasi sistem komputasi antara server lokal UGM dengan infrastruktur GPU Merdeka milik Indosat yang berada pada platform Cloudeka milik Lintasarta. 

![](/brand/uploads/notes/653-1-image-14-1030x739.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/653-2-image-3-1030x579.webp)

Dalam pertemuan tersebut juga diperkenalkan kerangka teknologi yang disediakan oleh NVIDIA dan Indosat untuk mendukung pengembangan proyek Tropical Precision Agriculture. Teknologi ini mencakup dukungan pengolahan data dari berbagai sumber seperti _drone_, kamera, dan sensor lapangan, pemrosesan data di perangkat _edge_, pengembangan model kecerdasan artifisial, hingga sistem analitik dan visualisasi yang dapat mendukung pengambilan keputusan dalam pengelolaan pertanian berbasis data. 

Sebagai salah satu tim riset yang akan berkontribusi dalam _research showcase_, tim FTP UGM menyiapkan berbagai inovasi teknologi pertanian presisi yang memanfaatkan integrasi sensor lapangan, analisis data, serta kecerdasan artifisial untuk meningkatkan efisiensi pengelolaan lahan dan sumber daya pertanian.  Upaya ini sejalan dengan komitmen terhadap Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (_Sustainable Development Goals_/SDGs), khususnya SDG 2 (Tanpa Kelaparan) melalui peningkatan produktivitas pertanian, SDG 9 (Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur) melalui pemanfaatan teknologi kecerdasan artifisial, serta SDG 13 (Penanganan Perubahan Iklim) melalui pengembangan sistem pertanian yang adaptif dan berbasis data. 

Melalui keterlibatan dalam pengembangan NVAITC ini, tim FTP UGM menegaskan komitmennya dalam mengembangkan inovasi teknologi pertanian berbasis data dan kecerdasan artifisial yang aplikatif dan berkelanjutan. Kolaborasi antara perguruan tinggi dan industri ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat pengembangan riset serta mendorong transformasi digital di sektor pertanian.
